acts.label: Prologue
acts.desc: Ira Glass introduces Reaching Out, a podcast that feels like it invented something completely new — an ambitious way of capturing a life in a way we'd never heard before.

acts.label: Part One
acts.desc:
Sayre Quevedo and his brother start the search for their birth father, and they discover that this whole time he’s been a few minutes away from where Sayre lives.
Reaching Out was produced by Sayre Quevedo and edited by Maria Garcia.
acts.credits: By Sayre Quevedo; Produced by Nadia Reiman

acts.label: Part Two
acts.desc: The twins try reaching out in a variety of ways before taking more direct action. Sayre tries to continue life as normal.

acts.label: Part Three
acts.desc: Sayre and Connor go in person to face their dad.
